fixed_statement:
Work on the modular geometric lattice \(\cL(M)\).
Let \(F\mapsto F^\perp\) be an order-reversing involution.

The tropical Plucker relations are local relations in length-four intervals of \(\cL(M)\), and the tropical incidence relations for a pair of quotients are the corresponding local flag-Plucker relations. The involution \(F\mapsto F^\perp\) sends length-four intervals to length-four intervals, interchanges rank \(s\) with rank \(d-s\), preserves the tropical Plucker relations under pullback, and reverses the flag incidence relations.
fixed_proof: This is the modular-lattice version of ordinary valuated-matroid duality, obtained by replacing set-complement in the Boolean case by the lattice anti-isomorphism.
